findings.title: Meu trabalho: detalhe invocado sem projection.work-item no host instalado
findings.affected: UI30/U41, route projection.work-item, details and source navigation

sources.role: UI calls projection.work-item on row selection
handler list lacks work-item; comment states unavailable read+verify ports
only handlers returned from work adapter are mounted

findings.causal: Click My Work row -> selectWork invokes projection.work-item, registered in client/schema but not returned by createSfWorkProjectionHandlers -> native router has no route for it; legacy fallback does not supply an explicitly admitted native handler. Exact HTTP outcome unexecuted.
findings.expected: Source-backed detail visible and destination independently reauthorized, with same owner/ref/version, both web and desktop.
findings.correction: 132 obtain real workDestinations.read/verify producer with bounded authority, register route in native handler map; N11 preserve selection and display proper denied/stale/unavailable states. No stub or success simulation.
findings.validation_request: 150/Q01/Q02 installed row selection, authorized work-item and denied/revoked/stale/cross-owner/desktop checks on final frozen C; 149 compile and SDK contract.

findings.title: Agenda de revisões depende de projection.review que não está montada no host

sources.role: registered native handler list omits review factory
unmatched projections fall through to business

findings.causal: UI47 calls GET /api/ui/projections/review; metadata and server factory exist, but entry does not import or inject the factory and the native router only mounts the explicitly supplied array. Missing wired projection for agenda in inspected composition.
findings.expected: Authorized review agenda can discover real sections under original Request; cannot treat absence as empty list.
findings.correction: 132 compose A07 factory using real scoped authority, source/business/review services (no fabricated ports); ensure route metadata/SDK and UI source schema match; do not overwrite other source areas.
findings.validation_request: 150/Q01+Q02 installed agenda discover, source changes/revocation and successful preserve; 149 compiler. Same frozen C.

findings.title: Busca livre trafega como q em GET URL contra NAV-01

owner.writer: N10/PR147 UI search + A12/transport contract owner

findings.affected: UI31/U42 search, text privacy, HTTP request path

sources.role: query string q read and dispatched

contract.rule: Texto livre de busca fica fora da URL; compartilhamento somente por ação explícita e contrato

findings.causal: Free-form search term becomes q in GET URL. It is transported in request URI and potentially logged/cached outside the authorized data envelope despite no-store on the response; not necessarily browser address bar.
findings.expected: Free text kept out of URL on web and desktop, with current authorization, redacted logs and no unauthorized share links.
findings.correction: A12+132 freeze safe input/route contract (e.g. source-admitted POST read with bounded body and idempotency rule), adapt N10 UI and tests; avoid pretending transport-only change is semantically compatible.
findings.validation_request: 150/Q01/Q02 verify HTTP/desktop URL and log/request capture contains no raw search content; 149 compile contract; final same C.

findings.title: CAP06 CTA primária Abrir estrutura permanece sempre desabilitada
findings.affected: CAP06/U03 -> CAP07/U47 navigation and keyboard users
findings.causal: Page advertises an 'open-team-structure' primary action while hard-disabling it regardless of allowed CAP07; the capability has an implemented structure leaf, so no keyboard or pointer transition through this control.
findings.expected: Action navigates to authorized CAP07 with owner-preserving route builder, or is not advertised as an available primary action when access is denied.
findings.correction: N14 wire actual frozen route builder and permission, preserve no implicit cross-owner fallback; 132 supply registry entry/ACK.
findings.validation_request: 150/Q02 keyboard and screen-reader navigation CAP06 -> CAP07, denied role, deep-link/back with focus and at 320/400% reflow.

caseRef exists in authorized source output

findings.title: Meu trabalho bloqueia navegação para fonte em desktop por comparação de origins

sources.role: safeSourceHref rejects renderer origin distinct from authorized public origin
on undefined valid link, detailState partial instead of opening source

findings.causal: Desktop runs on distinct renderer origin. Even if the producer returns an authorized same-installation source path, window.location.origin !== publicOrigin makes safeSourceHref fail, so the source navigation cannot resolve. No unsafe direct desktop href should be substituted.
findings.expected: Desktop may open approved in-app source destination via D01 owner-validated navigation broker without reusing a browser publicOrigin comparison.
findings.correction: 132/D01 define permitted desktop internal navigation/broker route and N11 use it without arbitrary web URLs. Recheck after F146-001 producer is installed.
findings.validation_request: 150/Q01/Q02 original desktop installed session opens authorized source, denies cross-origin and userinfo/hash, preserves access revocation.
